evidence.name: Screen field: Gradient on the main button
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Gradient on the main button" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Gradient on the main button
sections.description: An optional color gradient layered over the button's solid fill — set start and end colors, the angle, extra color stops, and an optional moving shimmer. Leave it off for a clean flat look; turn it on to make the call-to-action pop against a busy background. Keep enough contrast that the label stays easy to read.
